# Aria Dental

> Aria Dental is a done-for-you growth partner for dental practices that want to grow. The package is website design and development, SEO, Google Business Profile management (including a response to every patient review), Instagram and TikTok content creation and posting, ongoing client relations with a dedicated point of contact, and Aria, an AI voice receptionist.

Aria Dental is a product of Velzyx AI Inc. Aria is staff support, not a staff replacement. It covers after hours, lunch breaks, and busy moments, so patients can book when no one can pick up. Aria is custom-built for each practice. A patient can call to ask if a crown is ready and whether the appointment can be moved sooner, and Aria handles that on the call instead of transferring to the front desk. Aria works with Dentrix, Eaglesoft, and Open Dental. We sign a BAA with practices.

We currently manage marketing — Google Business Profile, website, and SEO — for H-Town Dental’s four Houston locations. No stats, results, quotes, or testimonials are published for that work.

## What the site says Aria does

- Answers assigned inbound lines, including overflow while the desk is with a patient, and coverage day or night.
- Works across voice, chat, and SMS.
- Can check insurance eligibility during the call, including a parent calling for a dependent, when the practice turns that on.
- Books visit types and providers the practice has approved.
- Aria works with Dentrix, Eaglesoft, and Open Dental.
- Can forward a call to the front desk when the desk is open, or leave a callback with who called, why, and what the caller was told.
- Sends clinical questions (including pain, medication, and post-op) to the practice. Aria does not invent those answers.
- Sits on the practice's existing phone system. The FAQ says no number port is required.
- Spanish is supported on voice and chat.
- The FAQ says most single-location practices are answering live calls within 2–7 days after a 30-minute kickoff.
- We sign a BAA with practices.
- Pricing is three tiers (Solo, Growing, and DSO) and scales with call volume and locations. A specific quote is scoped to the practice.

## What Aria does not do

- Aria answers inbound calls. It does not dial an overdue recall list or place outbound recall. That work stays with the practice.
- The site names H-Town Dental’s four Houston locations as a current marketing client. It does not publish stats, results, quotes, a miss rate, or a no-show reduction percentage.
